# Road trip car checklist

Used for the Highlands trip (May 2024, 1,140 miles in the Astra) and the Cornwall weekend (Aug 2025, first long one in the MG). Tick the lot the evening before, not the morning of.

## Week before

- [ ] Oil level on the dipstick, top up to max (Astra only, it drank about 0.5L per 2,000)
- [ ] Coolant at the MAX line, cold
- [ ] Screenwash, 50/50 concentrate in the tank
- [ ] Wiper blades: any streaking, swap. Bosch AeroTwin AR653S fits the Astra
- [ ] Tread depth all 4 + spare, at least 3mm. Pressures to the full load numbers in [[Tyre pressure]]
- [ ] Bulbs: get Lucía to stand behind while I do brakes, indicators, reverse
- [ ] Breakdown cover active? Green Flag, policy GF-88213047, renews 3 June

## Boot kit (lives there permanently)

- [ ] Jump leads (after the January 2024 episode, see [[Car battery jump start]])
- [ ] Ring inflator, tyre gauge
- [ ] Warning triangle, hi-vis x2
- [ ] Locking wheel nut key! In the glovebox, the "W" one
- [ ] Torch with fresh AAAs
- [ ] First aid kit, the red bag. Checked expiry Jun 2025
- [ ] 1L of oil, 1L of coolant, Gorilla tape, cable ties, multitool
- [ ] Blanket, 2 bottles of water, cereal bars

## Day before

- [ ] Fuel to full / charge to 100% (MG)
- [ ] Download offline maps, the Highlands had no signal for an hour past Kinlochewe
- [ ] Phone charger + the 12V USB adaptor
- [ ] Toll cash/card, parking apps logged in
- [ ] Bags: one each, soft, see [[Packing list carry-on]] which is basically the same list
- [ ] Route and stops, [[Road trip Scotland]] has the Highlands one

## EV extras

- [ ] Type 2 cable in the boot (not just the tethered home one)
- [ ] Apps: Zapmap, Ionity, Instavolt, Gridserve. Card added on each
- [ ] Plan rapid stops at 20%, not 5%. MG charges at up to 76 kW but slows above 80%
- [ ] Check [[EV charging at home]] notes for preconditioning

## After

- [ ] Wash the salt/bugs off
- [ ] Log mileage: Highlands start 113,210, end 114,350
